title: Fisher-information training of optical sensing front ends from natural fluctuations
summary: Fisher-information-based optimization of programmable optical front ends in situ generally requires a response model or parameter-labeled measurements. We show that natural parameter fluctuations can instead provide the training signal. We construct proxies for the Fisher information (FI) of one parameter and the prior-weighted FI spectrum of multiple parameters from measured covariances after subtracting conditional detection noise, assuming locally affine responses.
